question: The Nobel Peace Prize 2020 was awarded to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Food Programme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **UN World Food Programme (WFP), which provides lifesaving food assistance to millions across the world- often in extremely dangerous and hard-to-access conditions- has been awarded the 2020 Nobel Peace Prize.**
 
• The agency was recognized "for its efforts to combat hunger, for its contribution to bettering conditions for peace in conflict-affected areas and for acting as a driving force to prevent the use of hunger as a weapon of war and conflict.
 
• **WFP is the largest humanitarian organization in the world. Last year, it assisted 97 million people in 88 countries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Nobel Peace Prize:**

 
 
• It is one of the five Nobel prizes established by the will of Swedish industrialist, inventor and armaments manufacturer Alfred Nobel, along with the prizes in Chemistry, Physics, Physiology or Medicine and Literature.
 
• It was established in 1895 and First awarded in 1901.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Monetary Fund:**

 
 
• It works to achieve sustainable growth and prosperity for all of its 190 member countries.
 
• It does so by supporting economic policies that promote financial stability and monetary cooperation, which are essential to increase productivity, job creation, and economic well-being.
 
 
 
• **Amnesty International:**
 
 
• It is an international non-governmental organization focused on human rights, with its headquarters in the United Kingdom.
 
 
 
• **World Health Organization:**
 
 
• It is a specialized agency of the United Nations, established in 1948.
 
• The constitution of WHO was signed by 61 countries in 1946.
